user.title: Connect HASS QuestDB Writer
user.description: Configure the QuestDB ILP/HTTP destination. Leave the credentials empty when QuestDB runs without authentication.

init.title: Entity filter
init.description: Choose which entities are written to QuestDB. Domains and globs are comma-separated, for example: sensor, binary_sensor and sensor.kitchen_*. Attribute patterns also support * and ?, for example: friendly_name, unit_*, rssi.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Experimental tuning limits. The defaults are a development profile and are not yet validated for production.
